readings: Link each signal to its telescope and that telescope's observatory, dropping signals that don't match. For each telescope and weather profile (`weathprofile`), work out the average modulation index and the average phase shift. Keep the telescope/weather groups whose average modulation index is above the mean of those group averages, with each group counting equally. Then for each weather profile, return the weather profile, the average of the kept groups' average modulation index, the average of their average phase shift, and the average amount by which their modulation index is above that baseline. Don't round anything.
queries:
WITH telescope_weather AS (
    SELECT
        t.telescregistry,
        o.weathprofile,
        AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex,
        AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift
    FROM signals AS s
    JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_modindex
    FROM telescope_weather
)
SELECT
    tw.weathprofile,
    AVG(tw.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
    AVG(tw.avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift,
    AVG(tw.avg_modindex - b.mean_modindex) AS avg_above_baseline
FROM telescope_weather AS tw
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE tw.avg_modindex > b.mean_modindex
GROUP BY tw.weathprofile
